text:
alice_support: Customer JD — mid-stream SSE disconnects when users flip from cellular to corporate VPN. Partial tokens arrive then EventSource error and readyState=2. Affects iOS WebView and Android in-app browsers.

customer_jd: Repro steps: 1) Start chat in app on LTE, 2) Trigger long response (~60s), 3) Enable corporate VPN (users toggle or VPN auto-connect), 4) Stream stops after ~8-20s with partial message. Console: "EventSource error, readyState=2". Server logs show remote reset.

samira_engineer: Can you paste client logs + server snippet and confirm whether you use ALB / GCP LB / envoy in front? Also last-event-id header usage?

customer_jd: Logs: 
```
Client: EventSource error, readyState=2
Client: fetch error: net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET
Server: 2025-10-11T14:12:05Z stream: send chunk id=abc123
Server: 2025-10-11T14:12:13Z tcp: connection reset by peer (errno=104)
```
They said infra: AWS ALB -> nginx -> app (node).

mike_sre: Likely network path change induced TCP RST / TLS session drop when VPN tunnels bring new NAT. Mobile OS sometimes kills long-lived sockets during WWAN->VPN transitions. ALB idle timeout or nginx proxy timeouts can make it worse.

mike_sre: Quick checks: 1) ALB idle timeout (default 60s) — increase to 120-300s for SSE. 2) nginx: set proxy_read_timeout and send keepalive pings from app every 15s. 3) set downstream tcp_keepalive settings on node host. 4) capture pcap from device / server during repro.

devx_jordan: Client-side mitigations: add reconnect-with-last-event-id and short retry. Example: 
```
function connect(lastId){
  const es = new EventSource(url, { withCredentials: true });
  es.onmessage = e => { lastId = e.lastEventId || lastId; handleChunk(e.data); };
  es.onerror = () => { if (es.readyState === EventSource.CLOSED) setTimeout(()=>connect(lastId), 800); };
}
connect();
```
Also consider using small noop comments (":

") from server as SSE keepalive so proxies won't classify stream idle.

vpn-bot: Note from vendors: Some corporate VPN clients (esp older SSL VPNs) tear up TCP sockets during rekey or routing table changes; that's normal for some stacks. Persistent socket resume isn't supported.

samira_engineer: Action plan: 
- ask customer for device pcap & server-side tcpdump during repro 
- increase ALB idle_timeout to 180s for their LB (if they approve) 
- add server-side SSE keepalive every 12-15s (simple "\n\n" comment) in app while streaming 
- deploy nginx proxy_read_timeout + proxy_send_timeout bump on their environment 
- get ENG-RUNTIME to audit whether our fronting proxy (envoy) has stream_idle_timeout too low

alice_support: JD, can we run ALB timeout bump and add keepalive patch as temporary mitigation while you gather pcaps? If yes we'll schedule a maintenance window.

customer_jd: Ack, please proceed with ALB change and keepalive patch. I will collect device pcap and share. Thanks. :thumbsup:

samira_engineer: Thanks — I'll open an ENG-RUNTIME ticket if envoy config needs change and cc SRE. if we still see RSTs after keepalive + timeout bump we'll ask for PCAP and escalate to network team.

mike_sre: Filed infra ticket INF-8329 to review idle timeouts + tcp_keepalive sysctl on their nodes. Also tagging in network for possible VPN vendor issues.

alice_support: Closing loop here, monitoring. If JD sees further disconnects after the patch we'll reopen and attach pcaps.
